Personal & Confidential

Saniaaa Ke Naam Pyaara Paigam

Today's Special Edition

Pyaari Saniaaa, 🌸

Agle kuch minutes ke liye bas shanti se yeh padhna. Life me bohot saare log aate hain aur jaate hain, par kuch log aise hote hain jo aate hi aapki duniya ko aur bhi khubsurat bana dete hain. Tum mere liye bilkul wahi ho.

Mujhe yaad hai jab hamari dosti shuru hui thi, kabhi socha nahi tha ki tum meri life ka itna important part ban jaogi. Tumhari nadaniyan, tumhara cute gussa, tumhara har baat pe care dikhana, aur wo sweet hassi... yeh sab chizein tumhe sabse alag banati hain.

“Dosti wahi hoti hai jahan lafzon ki zaroorat na pade, aur tumhare saath mujhe kabhi dikhawa karne ki zaroorat nahi padi.”

Main bhagwan se bas yahi pray karta hu ki tumhari life hamesha khushiyon se bhari rahe. Tum jo bhi banna chahti ho, jahan bhi jana chahti ho, tumhe har jagah kamyabi mile.

Kabhi agar udaas ho ya akela feel ho, toh bas itna yaad rakhna ki tumhara yeh dost hamesha ek call ki doori par khada hai.

Thank you for being you. Life is so much sweeter with you around! 💕

From the heart, just for you
